content.value: A business analyst is developing a traceability matrix to determine whether or not any gaps exist and to identify any discrepancies.

Question #: 2.Title: Exam PMI-PBA topic 1 question 2 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: A business analyst has been asked to investigate a problem. This investigation will provide input towards developing a business case. The business analyst wants to first understand the company’s current business processes.
Which technique should the business analyst use?

B. RACI matrix
